description: This bar chart illustrates the correlation values for four different knowledge popularity metrics—PopGT, PopGe, RPopGT, and RPopGe—across three domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis displays the three domains in alphabetical order, while the vertical axis represents the correlation value, ranging from 0 to 0.7 on a linear scale. Each domain contains four grouped bars, each corresponding to one of the four metrics as indicated by the legend: PopGT (solid orange), PopGe (orange with diagonal hatching), RPopGT (solid blue), and RPopGe (blue with diagonal hatching). For the Movies domain, the correlation values are approximately 0.25 for PopGT, 0.1 for PopGe, 0.35 for RPopGT, and 0.6 for RPopGe. In the Songs domain, the values are approximately 0.3 for PopGT, 0.1 for PopGe, 0.5 for RPopGT, and 0.7 for RPopGe. For the Basketball domain, the values are approximately 0.1 for PopGT, 0.1 for PopGe, 0.15 for RPopGT, and 0.25 for RPopGe. The bars are not sorted and are visually grouped within each domain, with no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding applied to any specific bar.
